thread:
Avery: heads up — tenant reported v2 requests billed to v1 quota in staging
Maria: ouch. any sample request/headers?
Avery: got one: curl -X POST /generate -H 'X-Client-Version: v2' -H 'X-Session-Id: s1'
Sahil: we sticky by session id for 24h. if session was pinned earlier to v1 that could explain it.
Jordan: also possible: fallback rewrites happen after ingress attribution, so billing sees v1.
Maria: we should make billing tag explicit. proposal: add final_billing_tag emitted by runtime and reconciled back to billing.
Avery: agree. ingress emits initial placeholder, runtime emits final tag, billing reconciler upserts. console shows billed tag + reason (fallback|pinned|capacity).
Sahil: add telemetry metric billing_tag_mismatch and alert if >0.1% per-tenant.
Jordan: safety: prevent automatic rebilling if final tag maps to a different tenant's reserved pool.
deploy-bot: Created INFRA-2249: routing -> billing tag reconciliation (https://tickets.redwood.ai/INFRA-2249)
Avery: I'll write a tiny RFC and PR with proto diff. tagging @Maria @Sahil @Jordan for review.
